title: Train High, Ship Low: Efficient LoRA Synchronization for Distributed On-Policy Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.13306v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transmitting LoRA adapters to rollout workers can bottleneck distributed on-policy post-training over bandwidth-constrained networks. Lowering the training rank may limit the capacity a workload needs, while adaptive optimizer updates are difficult to compress. Rollout workers can instead reconstruct updates from gradients by maintaining replicated optimizer states. We introduce HiLo, a compressor-agnostic framework that replaces parameter transmission with compressed gradient dissemination and local optimizer replay. By applying the same decoded gradients, the learner and workers maintain consistent policy states at the same version under reproducible execution. We further develop Spar, a budget-aware gradient compressor that combines spectral truncation, adaptive rank allocation and error feedback to decouple training rank from communication cost. translated_abstract: 在带宽受限的网络上，将 LoRA 适配器传输给 rollout 工作节点可能成为分布式在线策略后训练的瓶颈。降低训练秩可能会限制工作负载所需的模型容量，而自适应优化器的更新又难以压缩。相反，rollout 工作节点可以通过维护复制的优化器状态，从梯度中重建更新。我们提出了 HiLo，一个与压缩器无关的框架，它以压缩梯度分发和本地优化器重放取代参数传输。通过应用相同的解码后梯度，学习器与工作节点在可复现执行下能在同一版本上保持一致的策略状态。我们进一步开发了 Spar，一种预算感知的梯度压缩器，它结合谱截断、自适应秩分配和误差反馈，将训练秩与通信成本解耦。在在线策略蒸馏和奖励引导后训练上的实验表明，HiLo……
tldr: 提出与压缩器无关的 HiLo 框架，用压缩梯度分发加本地优化器重放取代 LoRA 参数传输，并配套预算感知的 Spar 梯度压缩器，将训练秩与通信成本解耦，从而在带宽受限网络上高效实现分布式在线策略后训练。
en_tdlr: HiLo replaces LoRA adapter transmission with compressed gradient dissemination and local optimizer replay, and together with Spar—a budget-aware gradient compressor using spectral truncation, adaptive rank allocation, and error feedback—it decouples training rank from communication cost for efficient distributed on-policy post-training over bandwidth-constrained networks.
